gaps.explanation: Schedule is 69,319 above the statement. Detail records these as the revenue lines 'Local (Insurance proceeds)' 20,852, 'Local (Sale of surplus)' 9,659 and 'Local (Sale of surplus)' 38,808, split from the printed budget-schedule Local amounts. Printed totals: budget schedules 3,718,831 + 1,921,916 vs statement General 4,135,662 - inheritance 447,342 and Road 1,883,108. All other receipt lines tie (nonmajor Intergovernmental 42,706 + 8,580 = 51,286; Local 1,571 + 9,540 + 49,000 + 4,974 = 65,085; Taxes 6,959 + 6,959 = 13,918). No fix.
